name.en: Business Angel Network of Southeast Asia (BANSEA)

strategy.thesis: Oldest established angel network in Southeast Asia; promotes the development of the angel investment community through education, research and matching early-stage companies with member angels. Membership is by invitation/recommendation only, with monthly investor pitch meetings.

people.name: Dr. Poh Kam Wong
people.role: Founder (2001); Professor & Director, NUS Entrepreneurship Centre

application.how_to_apply: Startups pitch at monthly investor meetings; membership for angels is by invitation and recommendation by existing members.

summary.en: Founded in 2001 by NUS professor Poh Kam Wong, BANSEA is the leading and oldest angel investment network in Southeast Asia, with 100+ members, 400+ invested companies and two member funds (BANSEA One 2016, BANSEA Two 2018). It focuses on seed and early-stage deals of roughly $100K–$1M and counts Carousell, Carro, ShopBack and 99.co among portfolio companies.

sources.supports: Mission, founding year, members count, invested companies, funds
sources.quote: BANSEA is the leading Angel Investment network promoting the development of the Angel Investment community in Southeast Asia. ... Established in 2001 ... 100+ members and counting ... 400+ invested companies ... 15,000+ founders supported ... Membership in BANSEA is strictly by invitation and recommendation by existing members.

strategy.thesis: Angel investment network that trains angels and provides curated deal flow and syndication services, bridging effective angels with quality startups across Southeast Asia. Provides ~40–50 curated startup opportunities per year.

application.how_to_apply: Startups register/apply for curated pitch sessions; angels join via workshops and membership.

summary.en: Incorporated in February 2018 by JobsCentral founders Huang Shao-Ning, Lim Der Shing and Phey Teck Moh, AngelCentral is a Singapore- and SEA-focused angel network providing angel-investor training, curated deal flow (40–50 deals/year) and syndication. It has trained over 1,000 angels, and members have invested over S$38M into startups.

strategy.thesis: Investment network of senior tech leaders (alumni of Google, Grab, Gojek, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft and others) backing early-stage technology startups from pre-seed to pre-Series A, originally founded by Google alumni in SEA.

application.how_to_apply: Startups pitch to the network; membership is for senior tech executives.

summary.en: Founded in 2018 as Xoogler Angels by Google alumni in Southeast Asia, XA Network is a Singapore-based angel network of ~100 senior tech executives from companies like Grab, Gojek, Google, Amazon and Meta. It has made 100+ investments (pre-seed to pre-Series A) across mobility, fintech, edtech and SaaS, including Neuron Mobility, Osome and Intellect, with three exits to date.

strategy.thesis: Fully digital angel syndicate / 'AngelList for SEA' democratizing access to venture-backed startups; lets angels co-invest alongside regional and global VCs with minimums as low as USD 3,000 per deal. Sector-agnostic with cross-border deal flow.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via the A2D platform for deal access; founders pitch for syndicate funding.

summary.en: Launched in Bangkok in 2023 by Ankit Upadhyay and co-founders, A2D Ventures bills itself as Southeast Asia's largest angel syndicate and fastest-growing angel investing platform. Fully digital, it lets investors back early-stage SEA startups with minimums as low as USD 3,000 across AI, fintech, EV, deeptech, biotech and foodtech, spanning Thailand, Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and Vietnam.

strategy.thesis: First and largest angel investor network in Indonesia: 70+ prominent business leaders pooling resources for early-stage investment and mentoring, with an in-house investment team and a separate ANGIN Advisory arm for research and capacity building. Strong women-founder and impact focus.

application.how_to_apply: Startups apply via ANGIN for investment matching and advisory; angels join the network of business leaders.

summary.en: Founded around 2014 and led by David Soukhasing, ANGIN is the first and largest angel investor network in Indonesia, composed of 70+ prominent business leaders backed by a full-time investment team. It has cumulatively invested in 60+ startups, runs ANGIN Advisory for research/capacity-building, and is a member of the ASEAN Angel Alliance.
summary.local: ANGIN (Angel Investment Network Indonesia) adalah jaringan angel investor pertama dan terbesar di Indonesia, didirikan sekitar 2014 dan dipimpin oleh David Soukhasing, beranggotakan 70+ pemimpin bisnis dengan tim investasi penuh waktu, telah berinvestasi di 60+ startup.

verification_notes: Founding year reported as 2014 (Soukhasing's leadership/LinkedIn and most secondary sources) although ANGIN's About page references 2016 'inception'; used 2014. Portfolio figures vary (35+ earlier, 60+ cumulative); used 60+ cumulative.

strategy.thesis: Official trade association and governing body for angel investors and angel clubs in Malaysia, responsible for accreditation of individual angels and angel clubs, education, awareness and monitoring angel-investment statistics. Administers the Angel Tax Incentive; Cradle Fund's Angel Tax Incentive Office acts as its secretariat.

application.how_to_apply: Angels apply for MBAN accreditation; the body governs and accredits angel clubs rather than investing directly.

summary.en: Established in 2012 (announced May 2012 at ABAF, officially launched 18 December 2012), MBAN is the official trade association and governing body for angel investors and angel clubs in Malaysia, handling accreditation, education and angel-investment statistics, and administering the Angel Tax Incentive. Its secretariat is run by Cradle Fund's Angel Tax Incentive Office in Kuala Lumpur.

sources.title: The Malaysian Business Angel Network (MBAN) - About Us
sources.supports: Role, HQ, key people, Cradle relationship
sources.quote: the official trade association and governing body for angel investors and angel clubs in Malaysia ... responsible for the accreditation of individual angel investors and angel investors clubs ... Cradle Fund Sdn Bhd, through its Angel Tax Incentive Office, acts as the secretariat for MBAN ... President: Peter Wee ... Chief Executive Officer: Ms. Tricia Ann Francis

sources.title: Angel Investors Malaysia / MBAN history (NEXEA)
sources.supports: Founding year
sources.quote: Cradle first announced the establishment of the Malaysian Business Angel Network (MBAN) at the Asian Business Angel Forum 2012 (ABAF 2012) in Kuala Lumpur in May 2012 before officially launching it on 18 December of the same year.

verification_notes: MBAN is a governing/trade body that accredits angels and clubs rather than a direct investor, so it has no portfolio of its own. Founding year 2012 from secondary sources; not stated on the About page.

strategy.thesis: Combines an angel investment network with a venture capital fund and a startup accelerator; matches Malaysian/SEA early-stage startups with member angels and offers ecosystem support. Its president also leads MBAN.

application.how_to_apply: Startups apply via NEXEA's website for the accelerator/angel funding; accredited angels join the network.

summary.en: Established in 2015 and based in Petaling Jaya/Bandar Sunway, NEXEA is a leading Malaysian venture capital firm, angel investment network and startup accelerator. It connects early-stage SEA startups with member angels and provides ecosystem support (the firm cites US$500,000+ of partner support to startups).

strategy.thesis: Malaysian angel network formed with support from Cradle Fund to educate and organise angels and channel them into early-stage deals; one of the early angel clubs that helped build Malaysia's angel ecosystem alongside MBAN.

application.how_to_apply: Startups pitch to ViC angel members; angels join the circle.

summary.en: Virtuous Investment Circle (ViC) is a Malaysian angel network formed with Cradle Fund's support to educate angels and channel them into early-stage startup deals. It was one of the early angel clubs that helped develop Malaysia's angel-investment ecosystem alongside MBAN and is part of the pro-tem committee that helped formalise the country's angel groups.

verification_notes: Founding year (~2014) inferred from Cradle's 2012-onward ecosystem push and e27 coverage; not confirmed by a primary source. Website URL inferred. No portfolio or check-size data verified — low confidence.

strategy.thesis: Largest committed private investor network in the Philippines (non-stock, non-profit SEC-registered). Invests in pre-seed/seed/Series A startups that are globally scalable with strong IP and management; about half of its investments are impact-focused (financial inclusion, employment, education, environment).

application.how_to_apply: Startups apply/pitch via MAIN; founders are screened before member pitch sessions.

summary.en: Founded in 2016, Manila Angel Investors Network (MAIN) is the largest committed private investor network in the Philippines, a non-stock non-profit SEC-registered body with 100 members. It has 30+ portfolio companies (Taxumo, Kumu, 1Export, Gappify, Aqwire), has screened 500+ startups, and invests pre-seed to Series A with about half its deals impact-focused.

strategy.thesis: Thailand's first accredited and largest active angel investment group: successful investors, executives and entrepreneurs who identify and back seed and early-stage businesses with capital, contacts and mentoring. Described as Southeast Asia's first 'Venture Club'.

application.how_to_apply: Startups pitch to BVC members for seed/early-stage investment.

summary.en: Founded in 2014, Bangkok Venture Club is Thailand's first accredited and largest active angel investment group, a network of successful investors, executives and entrepreneurs in Thailand and SEA. It identifies and supports seed and early-stage businesses with capital, contacts and mentoring, and is a founding-era member of the ASEAN Angel Alliance.

name.local: Mạng lưới Nhà đầu tư Thiên thần Việt Nam

strategy.thesis: National business angel network ('Go Global From Vietnam') building Vietnam's angel-investment ecosystem and cross-border deal flow; founded by Vietnam's Ministry of Science and Technology together with MBAN, BANSEA and Vietnam's Leading Business Club, partly government-funded.

application.how_to_apply: Startups apply via VAN for connecting, education and mentoring to attract local and foreign angels.

summary.en: Established in 2018 by Vietnam's Ministry of Science and Technology together with MBAN, BANSEA and Vietnam's Leading Business Club, Vietnam Angel Network (VAN) is a national, partly government-funded angel network that connects, educates and mentors startups to attract local and foreign angel investment, with a 'Go Global From Vietnam' cross-border focus. It is a member of the ASEAN Angel Alliance.
summary.local: VAN (Vietnam Angel Network) thành lập năm 2018 bởi Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ cùng MBAN, BANSEA và Vietnam Leading Business Club, là mạng lưới nhà đầu tư thiên thần quốc gia nhằm xây dựng hệ sinh thái đầu tư thiên thần tại Việt Nam.

sources.title: Vietnam Angel Network - Crunchbase
sources.supports: Founding year, founders, mission, government funding
sources.quote: VAN was established in 2018 by four members: Vietnam's Ministry of Science and Technology (MOST), Malaysian Business Angels Network (MBAN), Business Angel Network of Southeast Asia (BANSEA), and Vietnam Leading Business Club. The network is partly funded by the government.

verification_notes: Founding year and founders confirmed; no own website found (LinkedIn used as primary link). No portfolio or check-size data disclosed. Distinct from iAngel (separate Vietnamese network).

strategy.thesis: Vietnamese angel investor network connecting angels with early-stage startups and providing high-quality mentoring, network access and strategy/execution input; ran an iAngel Acceleration program.

application.how_to_apply: Startups apply for angel connections and mentoring via iAngel.

summary.en: Started in June 2016 and based in Ho Chi Minh City, iAngel is a Vietnamese angel investor network connecting angels with early-stage startups and offering mentoring, network access and strategy/execution support. It has run an iAngel Acceleration program.
summary.local: iAngel (Mạng lưới nhà đầu tư thiên thần Việt Nam) bắt đầu hoạt động từ tháng 6/2016 tại TP. Hồ Chí Minh, kết nối nhà đầu tư thiên thần với startup giai đoạn đầu và cung cấp cố vấn, mạng lưới và hỗ trợ chiến lược.

strategy.thesis: Cambodia's angel investor network, initiated by the Cambodia Investors Club Association (CiC) to develop angel investing through an investor-education program and an investment gateway; startups pitch for $15,000–$250,000. Evolved from the 2018–19 BIO Investor Program.

application.how_to_apply: Startups join a ~5-month CAIN program of workshops and investment pitches; angels enrol in the investor-education program.

summary.en: Launched in October 2020 in Phnom Penh by the Cambodia Investors Club Association (CiC), CAIN is Cambodia's angel investor network, promoting angel investing via an investor-education program and an investment gateway. Startups pitch for investment between $15,000 and $250,000; the program evolved from the 2018–19 BIO Investor Program.
